newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DEL MONTE NAMES TRAHAR, BOYD TO BOARD.
newsitem.headline: DEL MONTE NAMES TRAHAR, BOYD TO BOARD.

text.p: South African foods group Del Monte Royal Corp (Delcor) said on Monday that it had appointed Tony Trahar chairman of Del Monte Royal Holdings Ltd.
Trahar, whose appointment follows the retirement of Graham Boustred, is also to be deputy chairman of Delcor and Del Monte Royal Foods Ltd (Delfood) .
Trahar is an executive director of Anglo American Industrial Corp Ltd (Amic).
The firm also said Leslie Boyd, Amic chairman, had been appointed to Delfood's board.

Last month Del Monte launched a restructuring of its operations which will cost 360 million rand. The firm also said that due to the trading performance of its business it had elected to write down the value of its trademarks and brands by 1.2 billion rand.
Del Monte said it expected to reap the full benefits of the restructuring by the third year of its implementation. The benefits are estimated at 100 million rand per year.
